# ChatSoap

> Invite-only platform where small teams collaborate in real time around a shared AI workspace: video plus shared AI, not screen sharing.

ChatSoap is built for tech leaders and small teams (2-4 participants) who want to think together with AI. Everyone in a room sees and contributes to the same AI conversation, can talk to an AI voice assistant that the whole room hears, and meets over HD video with real-time presence and reactions. Access is by invitation.
